Name: Desaturated Sprites for Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic SVE
Author: nvoc
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27392]Gojitagg's toned-down sprite replacements[/url] for Seasonal Outfits﻿﻿, i've created desaturated edits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url].

[center][b][size=4]This file [u]only includes assets that replaces the sprites[/u] of the Seasonal Outfits - SVE mod. [/size][/b]
Please see the installation section below for instructions.[/center]
Character portraits are untouched since I made these for personal use and using portrait replacement mods in my own game.

The optional files also includes [size=1](scuffed) [/size]desaturated edits of the portrait wall decor to [size=1](I hope)[/size] suit toned-down furniture mods.

[center]———[/center]
[center]There are 2 different versions: [b]slight [/b]and [b]extreme[/b].[/center]
[center]﻿[b]Slight:[/b] 30% less saturation
[b]Extreme:[/b] 45% less saturation[/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/RgFzwjO.gif[/img][/center][center][i][size=2](Better previews in the images tab since GIFs don't do colours justice sometimes)[/size][/i][/center]
[size=4][b]REQUIREMENTS
[/b][/size][list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]﻿ [/b](version 3.0.0)
[/list]
[b][size=4]INSTALLATION
[/size][/b][list]
[*]Only install one version; either [b]slight [/b]or [b]extreme[/b].
[*]Drag and drop the contents within the .zip folder into your Mods folder, or wherever the[b] [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE[/b] folder is located in there.
[*]Replace/overwrite all when asked.
[/list]
To uninstall, reinstall the original Seasonal Outfits SVE mod and replace the assets that way.

[center]———[/center][size=4][b]CREDITS[/b][/size]
[list]

[/list]
